evidence.evidence_text: Supposing you have a sensor in the bathroom, when you enter the light turns on, the door is closed and the heater turns on if the temperature is less than 15 degrees and signals outside on the switch or on a screen that the toilet is occupied.

coding.rationale: Evidence states the system signals outside that the toilet is occupied when someone enters, informing others; device-independent outcome is occupancy indication.

responsibility_name: Encourage studying before gaming during school study hours

evidence.evidence_text: During the school period if during study hours (2.00pm/6.00pm) the Playstation is detected in the bedroom area, Alexa will perform the voice notification "Are you sure*? If I were you, I would study first..."

coding.rationale: During school study hours a voice prompt discourages gaming and encourages studying; failure is study not done.

responsibility_name: Ensure waking at seven each morning

evidence.evidence_text: If it is 7:00, the alarm goes off.

coding.rationale: Alarm at 7:00 ensures waking by a deadline; failure is oversleeping (wake task not completed).

responsibility_name: help user wake up on weekday mornings

evidence.evidence_text: IF it is Monday and Tuesday AND the user does not get up from the bed before 7:30 RAISE the shutters AND TURN ON the coffee machine

coding.rationale: If user not up by 7:30 on weekdays, environment prompts waking; failure is oversleeping.

responsibility_name: prepare dining environment before scheduled dinner

evidence.evidence_text: IF dinner with friends is set at 20:00, WHEN it is 19:30 TURN ON the oven AND set dim lights mode in the dining room.

coding.rationale: At 19:30 before a 20:00 dinner, oven and lighting are set to prepare the dining environment.

evidence.evidence_text: Assuming you have an automated bathroom at home, have a sensor that recognizes when the hot water in the shower opens and when you go into the shower and activates the stereo by playing the music from your favorite playlists and which also recognizes a stop command in case you don't want to listen to music.

coding.rationale: Music plays during shower when hot water is detected, with stop option; failure is reduced comfort/enjoyment. Context is shower event rather than occupancy state.

responsibility_name: Support a consistent wake-up morning routine

evidence.evidence_text: When the sensor detects that the person gets out of bed, if the time is between 7:30 and 8:30, if the user's smart watch detects the heartbeat between 60 and 80, then the electric coffee machine comes on and the kitchen roller shutter goes up.

coding.rationale: On getting out of bed within 7:30-8:30 with normal heart rate, coffee and shutters activate to support a consistent morning routine.

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user studies AND the TV is on OR the smartphone's social networks are not in stand-by TURN OFF the TV AND enable stand-by mode for social apps.

coding.rationale: When studying, distractions (TV, social apps) are suppressed; failure is study interrupted. Applies whenever study occurs.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the bathroom and the time is between 7:00 and 8:00, the light goes on and the tap in the bathtub opens.

coding.rationale: Entering bathroom 7:00-8:00 triggers light and bath tap; failure is routine inconvenience. Time window makes context scheduled.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is in the room, if he says "reading mode" to Alexa or if he sets the reading mode from the smartwatch, then adjust the brightness of the lamp to 2 and set the smartphone to do not disturb

coding.rationale: On reading-mode command while in room, lighting adjusts and phone silenced for comfortable undistracted reading; failure is discomfort/distraction.

responsibility_name: wake up reliably in the morning

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user NOT switches off the alarm as soon as it starts sounding TURN ON the lights gradually AND RAISE the rolling shutters in successive steps.

coding.rationale: If alarm not switched off promptly, escalating lights/shutters ensure waking; failure is oversleeping.

responsibility_name: alert occupants to failed door access attempts

evidence.evidence_text: When the fingerprint reader does not recognize the fingerprint, it sends a notification to the mobile phone and rings the bell.

coding.rationale: Unrecognized fingerprint triggers notification and bell; guards against unauthorized access, a security failure if missed. Triggered by access event at threshold.

responsibility_name: avoid heating while windows are open

evidence.evidence_text: If I open the window and the heating is on, turn off the heating system and notify me with a notification

coding.rationale: Opening window while heating on triggers heating shutdown; prevents energy waste. Triggered by window-open event.

coding.rationale: On fire alarm or power outage, auxiliary lights turn on; ensures safety lighting during hazard events, preventing harm.
